n = int(input())
K = int(input())

MOD = 1000000007

def add(a, b):
    a += b
    if a >= MOD:
        a -= MOD
    return a

def mult(a, b):
    t = a * b
    if t >= MOD:
        t %= MOD
    return t

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, N, M):
        self.N = N
        self.M = M
        self.dat = [[0] * M for _ in range(N)]
    
    def init(self):
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                self.dat[i][j] = 0
    
    def iden(self):
        self.init()
        for i in range(min(self.N, self.M)):
            self.dat[i][i] = 1
    
    def trans(self):
        out = Matrix(self.M, self.N)
        for i in range(self.M):
            for j in range(self.N):
                out.dat[i][j] = self.dat[j][i]
        return out
    
    def __getitem__(self, x):
        return self.dat[x]
    
    def __setitem__(self, x, value):
        self.dat[x] = value
    
    def __add__(self, a):
        out = Matrix(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                out.dat[i][j] = add(self.dat[i][j], a.dat[i][j])
        return out
    
    def __mul__(self, x):
        out = Matrix(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                out.dat[i][j] = mult(self.dat[i][j], x)
        return out
    
    def matmul(self, a, b):
        out = Matrix(a.N, b.M)
        out.init()
        for i in range(a.N):
            for j in range(a.M):
                if a.dat[i][j]:
                    for k in range(b.M):
                        out.dat[i][k] = add(out.dat[i][k], mult(a.dat[i][j], b.dat[j][k]))
        return out

# Read input
n = int(input())
K = int(input())

# Initialize matrices
A = [[Matrix(35, 35) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(65)]
S = [[Matrix(35, 35) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(65)]
P = [[Matrix(35, 35) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(65)]
ans = Matrix(35, 35)

for i in range(K):
    A[0][i].iden()
    for j in range(K + 1):
        A[0][i].dat[i][j] = 1

length = K
i = 1
while length <= n:
    # Copy previous matrices
    S[i - 1][K - 1] = A[i - 1][K - 1]
    for j in range(K - 2, -1, -1):
        S[i - 1][j] = S[i - 1][j + 1]
        S[i - 1][j] = S[i - 1][j].matmul(A[i - 1][j], S[i - 1][j + 1])
    P[i - 1][0] = A[i - 1][0]
    for j in range(1, K):
        P[i - 1][j] = P[i - 1][j - 1].matmul(A[i - 1][j], P[i - 1][j - 1])
    A[i][0] = S[i - 1][0]
    for j in range(1, K):
        A[i][j] = S[i - 1][j].matmul(P[i - 1][j - 1])
    length *= K
    i += 1

# Convert n to base K digits
digit = []
temp_n = n
while temp_n:
    digit.append(temp_n % K)
    temp_n //= K

s = 0
ans.iden()

for i in range(len(digit) - 1, -1, -1):
    for j in range(digit[i]):
        ans = ans.matmul(A[i][(j + s) % K], ans)
    s = (s + digit[i]) % K

res = 1
for i in range(K):
    res = add(res, ans.dat[i][K])

print(res)
